notice.title: Privacy notice
notice.intro: {clinic} ({legalName}) collects the information below to handle your appointment request. Please read this notice before you agree. The service you choose and any reason for your visit are sensitive personal data under the Information Technology (SPDI) Rules, 2011, so we ask for your consent first. You only need to tick the box if you agree.

data.name: Name of the patient
data.service: The treatment or service you want to book
data.reason: Short reason for the visit or dental concern (optional)
data.guardian: If the patient is under 18: the parent or guardian's name and relationship
data.consentProof: Proof of your choices: date and time, notice version, language, browser type and a one-way hash of your IP address (never the IP address itself)
data.cookieId: A random ID stored in a cookie on your device
data.cookieChoices: The cookie categories you allow or refuse

APPOINTMENT.title: Booking and managing your appointment
APPOINTMENT.description: We use your details to schedule the appointment, call or message you to confirm or change it, and prepare for the visit. Needed to book.

FUNCTIONAL_COOKIES.title: Functional cookies
FUNCTIONAL_COOKIES.description: Remember settings such as your language between visits. Optional.

ANALYTICS_COOKIES.title: Analytics cookies
ANALYTICS_COOKIES.description: Count visits and see which pages are used so we can improve the website. Optional, off unless you turn it on.

MARKETING_COOKIES.title: Marketing cookies
MARKETING_COOKIES.description: Measure our advertising and show relevant offers. Optional, off unless you turn it on. We do not use any today.

notice.recipients: Only our clinic staff who handle appointments, each with access limited to their role. We do not share it with other organisations unless a law requires us to. No SMS, WhatsApp or email provider is used yet.
notice.withdraw: You can withdraw your consent at any time, as easily as you gave it: use "Cookie settings" at the bottom of any page, or one click on the Data Rights page with your reference ID. We then stop using the data for that purpose; this does not undo what was done before.
notice.rights: You can review and correct your information, and ask us to delete what we are not required to keep, on the Data Rights page.
notice.grievance: If you have a complaint, contact our Grievance Officer or use the Grievance page. We resolve grievances within one month.
notice.board: From about 13 May 2027 (date to be confirmed), the Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023 is expected to add further rights, including complaining to the {board} after using our grievance process.

cookie.title: Your cookie choices
cookie.text: We use cookies that are strictly necessary to run this site. With your permission, we would also like to use optional cookies. They are all off until you choose. Your choice applies straight away and you can change it any time from "Cookie settings" at the bottom of every page.
cookie.minorNote: Because you are booking for a patient under 18, analytics and marketing stay off for this visit.

necessary.title: Strictly necessary
necessary.description: Remember your cookie choices, keep the Data Rights page signed in and protect forms from abuse. The site cannot work without them, so they cannot be switched off.

functional.title: Functional
functional.description: Remember your preferred language between visits.

analytics.title: Analytics
analytics.description: Help us understand how the website is used. Not used today; nothing loads unless you allow it.

marketing.title: Marketing
marketing.description: Measure advertising and show relevant offers. Not used today; nothing loads unless you allow it.

booking.title: Book an appointment
booking.intro: Tell us when you would like to visit and we will call you to confirm.
booking.name: Patient's full name
booking.reasonHint: A few words are enough, e.g. "tooth pain on the left side". Please do not enter detailed medical history here: we will ask in person.
booking.guardianIntro: The patient is a child, so a parent or lawful guardian must give consent for them.
booking.guardianDeclaration: I declare that I am an adult (18 or over) and the parent or lawful guardian of this patient, and I am giving the consents below on their behalf.
booking.consentAppointment: I agree to {clinic} using the information above, including the sensitive personal data (the service and any reason for visit), to schedule and manage this appointment.
booking.successText: We will call you to confirm your slot.
booking.referenceHint: Keep this ID. You will need it, with your mobile number or email, to see, correct or erase your data or to withdraw consent on the Data Rights page.

errors.name: Please enter the patient's name.
errors.phone: Please enter a valid 10-digit mobile number.
errors.email: Please enter a valid email address or leave it empty.
errors.date: Please choose a date from today onwards.
errors.isMinor: Please tell us whether the patient is under 18.
errors.guardianName: Please enter the parent or guardian's name.
errors.guardianDeclaration: A parent or guardian must confirm this declaration.
errors.consentAppointment: We need your consent to book the appointment.

rights.title: Your data rights
rights.intro: Use this page to see, correct, update or erase your data, withdraw consent, nominate someone, or download your data. First we need to check it is you.
rights.codeSent: If the details match our records, we have sent a 6-digit code to that number or email. It expires in {minutes} minutes.
rights.lostReference: Lost your reference ID? Contact our Grievance Officer using the details below.
rights.accessIntro: A summary of the personal data we hold about you, how we use it and who we share it with.
rights.processorsHeading: Service providers (none receives your data yet)
rights.correctHeading: Correct, complete or update your details
rights.eraseIntro: We will erase everything we are not required by law to keep. Download your data first if you want a copy. If all your data is erased you will no longer be able to sign in here.
rights.eraseConfirm: I understand and want my data erased.
rights.nominateIntro: Choose a person who can exercise your rights if you die or become unable to do so.
rights.done: Done. We have recorded your request.
rights.clinicalRecord: Part of your clinical record (kept by law)
rights.fullyErased: All your personal data has been erased and you have been signed out.
rights.demoText: Codes are not sent in this test environment (DEMO_MODE). Your one-time code is:

legacyPurposes.APPOINTMENT_REMINDERS_SMS_WHATSAPP: Appointment reminders by SMS or WhatsApp (no longer offered)
legacyPurposes.MARKETING: Offers and clinic news (no longer offered)

rights.notConfigured: Not yet configured: none of your data is sent to it.

grievance.title: Raise a grievance
grievance.intro: If you are unhappy with how we have handled your personal information or a request, tell us here. Our Grievance Officer will resolve it within one month.
grievance.withoutReference: I don't have a reference ID
grievance.name: Your name
grievance.contactDetail: Mobile number or email for our reply
grievance.descriptionHint: Please do not include medical details we do not need to look into your complaint.
grievance.board: If you are not satisfied with our reply, you can contact the Grievance Officer again. From about 13 May 2027 (date to be confirmed), the Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023 is expected to also let you complain to the {board} after using this process.
grievance.duty: Please make sure the information you give is accurate. Please do not file a false or frivolous complaint.
